chapter: Harlem, Redman's band and the Savoy
title: Chick Webb's band as a source of musicians
summary: Webb's eight-piece band gave Hodges and Cootie Williams to Duke and once had Jimmy Harrison.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That must have been most interesting. And what about Chick, Chick Webb?

Do you know Chick Webb had a lot of great musicians in his band. A lot of great musicians came out of his band to go to other bands, you know. At one time Jimmy Harrison played with Chick Webb before he went to Fletcher. Chick Webb only had eight pieces. And Johnny Hodges played with Chick Webb. Duke got Johnny from Chick and Duke also got Cootie Williams from Chick Webb, you see.
Who -- Who'd you say, Jimmy Harrison?
Jimmy Harrison played with Chick Webb at one time.
He was the one that I told you was with Fletcher, --
